prompt:
Use case: product-mockup

Asset: Badge front artwork

Composition: 2:3 aspect ratio.

Create one flat, straight-on portrait-format employee badge artwork with a clean white background, charcoal sans-serif type, and a small burgundy #8b1e2d accent. Insert the supplied employee portrait without altering identity or reversing it. Exact text only: "KORVEX" at the top, "Riley Brooks" below the portrait, and "EMPLOYEE" as a small secondary label. The employer mark is a restrained KORVEX wordmark; no unrelated brand. Strong visual hierarchy and comfortable margins. No invented department, ID number, barcode, QR code, tiny filler text, lanyard, holder, perspective, or shadows. Check lettering in the output; final production artwork can be typeset cleanly after selection.

Rendering: Photorealistic premium live-action commercial look, physically plausible materials, believable anatomy and construction, controlled contrast, natural detail. No illustration, game screenshot, plastic skin, excessive bloom, or baked-in cinematic motion blur. Reference assets should be sharp enough to inspect. No decorative watermarks; the official contest watermark will be added during final editing.

Reference handling: Use the supplied images in the listed order and for their specified roles. Preserve selected designs; do not invent a new identity or silently replace a missing dependency.

Input images in order: badge-01.
review: Visually inspected; retained as test reference. Not user-approved final.
